description:
Create RESTful web services using Java 
 * Recommend, justify, and implement major changes to the web application architecture 
 * Provide technical leadership and expertise during the development/implementation phase 
 * Write code in Java, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS that meets the functional specifications 
 * Collaborate with UI Designer to prototype the user experience during the design phase 
 * Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues in the web application 
 * Propose and evaluate changes to the deployment architecture to improve performance, scalability, and/or manageability 
 Qualifications 
 

 Expert programmer in Java 
 Thorough understanding of Java EE architecture, with a focus on EJBs, JPA, and JAX-RS web services 
 Experience writing RESTful web services 
 Have worked within a microservices architecture 
 Ability to communicate technical design concepts to business and technical stakeholders 
 Operate at the leading edge of technology 
 Front-end web development experience with HTML5, JavaScript, and CSS3 is desirable 
 Understanding of AJAX, object-oriented JavaScript, the DOM and JSON 
 Experience with virtualization technologies like Oracle VM and VMWare 
 Have spent time as part of an agile development team (preferably Scrum) 
 5+ years of industry experience 
 BS/MS in computer science or related field.
 


 Java, Java EE, EJB's,JPA, JAX-RS,RESTful webservice,CSS3,HTML-5,programmer,
